<b>Cloverstags</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are placid natives of [[Verdania]], with their hide closely mimicking the flora of the land.<ref>Cloverstag Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Placid native of Verdania. Its hide closely mimics the flora of its territory."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Wanders a set path in rooms of Lost Verdania, doing short hops over the landscape and lilypads, making no effort to attack Hornet even if struck.

Despite their lack of hostility, Cloverstags still deal {{Damage|1}} contact damage.

== Location ==
Cloverstags can be found in [[Lost Verdania]].
